common.location: Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum
common.welcomeMessageContent: Preserving Heritage, Advancing Innovation; Refining Techniques, Shaping the Future
common.welcomeMessageContent2: The National Palace Museum stands as one of Taiwan's most treasured cultural landmarks. For thousands of years, priceless artifacts have survived the passage of time, preserving the legacy of human civilization. Within these halls, they are carefully safeguarded, thoughtfully exhibited, and continually reinterpreted. Each masterpiece not only embodies the memory of history but also reflects the enduring wisdom and cultural heritage of humankind.
common.welcomeMessageContent4: It is therefore especially meaningful that this year's Annual Meeting of the Taiwan Society of Endoscopic Spine Surgery is being held at the Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum. This venue symbolizes not only the convergence of medicine and culture, but also a dialogue between technological innovation and historical heritage. Within this remarkable institution that preserves the treasures of human civilization, we look forward to welcoming distinguished experts and colleagues from around the world to exchange cutting-edge techniques, scientific discoveries, and valuable clinical experiences, inspiring new ideas and future innovations.
common.welcomeMessageContent5: Today's medical advances will become tomorrow's history. Every effort we make in advancing endoscopic spine surgery today will serve as a cornerstone for future generations of surgeons and patients alike. We sincerely hope this Annual Meeting will provide an outstanding platform for academic exchange, international collaboration, and technological innovation, enabling us to achieve new milestones in minimally invasive spine surgery and to deliver safer, more effective, and higher-quality care for our patients.

common.welcomeMessageEnd: On behalf of the Taiwan Society of Endoscopic Spine Surgery, I warmly welcome all distinguished guests and colleagues. May this Annual Meeting be both scientifically rewarding and personally memorable, and may our shared commitment continue to shape the future of spine surgery.
common.welcomeMessageContent3: Endoscopic spine surgery represents the forefront of modern spinal care, embodying our continuous pursuit of precision and minimally invasive treatment. With ongoing advances in optical technology, surgical instrumentation, navigation systems, and biomaterials, many spinal disorders that once required extensive open procedures can now be treated through minimally invasive, highly precise, and safer techniques. These innovations have enabled faster recovery, reduced surgical morbidity, and improved quality of life for countless patients. Such achievements are the result of decades of dedication, innovation, and collaboration by endoscopic spine surgeons in Taiwan and around the world.
